review_rule: These GEM-listed parents have been manually reviewed as named steelmakers, steel manufacturing groups, or industrial mineral/metal producers behind the mapped plant. The list is an editorial industry-role screen, not issuer certification of each equity path. Every other GEM parent stays grey until separately established. Financial managers, unions, traders, consultancy and opaque holding/project vehicles are excluded.
